name: University of Glasgow
summary: A large university in the city of Glasgow, Scotland; honours degrees take four years, and degree pages give IB offers, e.g. 34 (6,5,5) for History.

ib.text: Each degree gives points and three HL grades, e.g. 34 (6,5,5) for History, 36 (6,6,5) with HL Maths AA for Economics. English A at SL or HL 5, or English B SL 6 or HL 5, meets the English requirement.

apply.via: UCAS, or Common App for some subjects

dates.label: UCAS deadline for Medicine, Dentistry and Veterinary Medicine
UCAS deadline for UK applicants (most degrees), 18:00 UK time
UCAS deadline for international students (EU students pay international fees)

notes: EU students pay the international fee: £28,275 a year for arts and social sciences and £33,708 for science and engineering in 2027/28.
International students can apply until 30 June, but Glasgow advises applying by the January deadline if you are unsure of your fee status.
You can apply for year 2 entry (Advanced Entry) and finish an honours degree in three years; if not accepted, you are considered for year 1.
